description: Lets an organization's Ojaldrado report mails be sent from a subdomain of its own: DKIM key, return-path MX and SPF, Resend Forge's return-path CNAME when it is asked for, and a monitoring DMARC policy when the subdomain has none.
variableDescription: dkimkey: the base64 DKIM public key given for this subdomain, after p=. region: the sending region of its return-path server (feedback-smtp.<region>.amazonses.com), such as eu-west-1. forge: the name before .rmta.net of the Resend Forge return-path target given for this subdomain, such as send.forge.
